definitions: An unincorporated community in Placer County, California, United States.

blocks.text: Applegate is an unincorporated community in Placer County, California. It is 7.25 mi (11,670 m) south-southwest of Colfax, and 9.3 mi (15.0 km) northeast of Auburn. The city's msl elevation is 2,005 ft (611 m). Its ZIP code is 95703 and its area code 530.

Applegate is a village in Sanilac County of the U.S. state of Michigan. The population was 241 at the 2020 census. Applegate is in the southeast corner of Washington Township on the boundary with Sanilac Township.
Applegate is an English surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Colleen Applegate (1963–1984), American actress known as Shauna Grant
Debby Applegate, American historian and biographer
Fred Applegate (actor), American actor, singer and dancer
John Stilwell Applegate (1837–1916), American politician, lawyer and writer
Rex Applegate (1914–1998), American military close combat instructor in World War II
Royce D. Applegate (1939–2003), American actor and screenwriter
